definitions.gloss: old age; advanced age; being elderly
definitions.explanation: The state of being old or having reached an advanced age. Used in formal, legal, and medical contexts more often than conversational speech.

examples.japanese: {老齢|ろうれい}⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧。
examples.english: An illness due to old age.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{老齢|ろうれい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{欠|か}かさない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: Even in his old age, my grandfather never misses his daily walk.

examples.japanese: {老齢|ろうれい}{年金|ねんきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受給|じゅきゅう}⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{原則|げんそく}→原則：11801_gensoku⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧65⟦{歳|さい}→歳：10017_sai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: Eligibility for old-age pension generally begins at age 65.

notes:
A formal word for old age, more common in written and official contexts than in conversation. In everyday speech, ⟦{高齢|こうれい}→高齢：14648_kourei⟧ or {年老|としお}いた are more natural.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {老齢|ろうれい}{年金|ねんきん}: old-age pension
- {老齢|ろうれい}⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧: due to old age
- {老齢|ろうれい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}する→達する：02129_tassuru⟧: to reach old age
- {老齢|ろうれい}⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧: aging (of a population)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{高齢|こうれい}→高齢：14648_kourei⟧: old age, advanced age — more neutral and widely used in formal and everyday speech
- ⟦{晩年|ばんねん}→晩年：27495_bannen⟧: later years of life — emphasizes the final stage of one's life
